headline: Plan Your Safari
subheadline: Speak to a Mombasa-based specialist. We respond within 24 hours.
form_subheadline: Tell us when you're arriving, where you're staying, and what you want to see. We'll send you a tailored itinerary and quote.
success_message: Thank you! Your enquiry has been received. Our team will craft a personalised response within 24 hours.
sidebar_body: We're not a booking engine. We're a small team of safari specialists who design every journey by hand.
